'''Nerril''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Answering to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Altiss]], he provided reconnaissance support for the Imperial forces during the [[Battle of Denova]].
